BL-1287 — leakedFixtureTunnelPids selects every temp-path cloudflared on the host with no scoping to the asking run, so bl857's module-load sweep SIGKILLs a concurrently-running sibling suite's LIVE fixtures in a parallel fork pool
What it solves: ## Relationship to the QA report that prompted this - read before assuming
## this ticket closes it
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a human tap. Two judgments worth a look before it goes.
First, the discriminator. The ticket asks for "is the creating run still alive?", not "is this process old?". A start-time cutoff is the obvious cheap alternative and it is NOT what is specified…
BL-1287 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1287" (or "reject BL-1287 <reason>") to act.
